title: Night of Breaking the Formation
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was about to retreat while holding Chen Nian, an ancient and majestic voice echoed from the depths of the Holy Sect—'Boy, put her down, and I may leave your corpse intact.' That was the aura of the Holy Sect's Grand Elder, as profound as an abyss, as terrifying as a prison, causing the entire battlefield to tremble. Chen Ji knew that the most dangerous situation since his debut had truly arrived.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji believed everything had settled, three vermilion signal flares suddenly blazed across the night sky beyond the Forbidden Grounds—these were the highest-level alerts from the Tianqing Sect. Master Mo's residual soul shot out from the first page, his voice unusually urgent: 'Trouble! The Holy Sect detected our movements ahead of schedule—their defensive repositioning came two hours earlier than anticipated!' Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingers gently stroking the fragments of the Tianji Record. The intricate threads of fate quivered intensely before him. He lifted his gaze toward the distant, faintly crimson-tinged night sky, his expression hardening with cold resolve: 'Since we've been exposed, we attack with full force. Transmit the order—execute the third contingency plan. Everyone must be in position within a quarter bell!'

In the Tianqing Sect's Council Hall, three vermilion flares detonated beneath the dome, flooding the entire chamber with blinding light. Ling Yuan occupied the main seat, his clouded old eyes flickering with a subtle gleam as he observed the signals. A faint smile curved his lips. 'Interesting... thattrash boy has finally made his move.' The attendant disciple beside him asked nervously, 'Sect Master, should we dispatch reinforcements immediately?' Ling Yuan waved dismissively, his tone unhurried: 'Not yet. Let them probe the Holy Sect's depths first.' His gaze deepened as he turned toward the Forbidden Grounds, as if penetrating the layers of formations to glimpse the figure orchestrating events within. Master Mo's voice resonated in Chen Ji's ear, carrying a note of genuine admiration: 'Impressive lad, maintaining composure under pressure—this steadiness surpasses even my younger self.'

dialogue.content: 'Master Mo, less talk.' Chen Ji drew a causal thread from the Tianji Record's fragments, watching it twist and entangle in the air before ultimately pointing toward the Holy Sect's most vulnerable defensive node. 'Found it—the connection point of the seventh formation, due northeast. A gap they've overlooked.' Master Mo marveled: 'Your ability to trace causality grows more refined. But I must warn you—each use drains your Heavenly Fate Value. You have only twenty-seven points remaining.' Chen Ji nodded, his gaze resolute: 'Twenty-seven points will suffice.'

text.content: Cold as a blade, the night wind swept across the Holy Sect's outer defensive perimeter, where dozens of spiritual barriers shimmered with an eerie, cold luminescence under the moonlight. Any approaching presence would be instantly obliterated. Chen Ji stood atop a hill, thirty elite alliance members arrayed behind him—each one carefully selected for this mission. Su Qingyao materialized beside him, her cyan garments billowing violently in the nocturnal gusts. 'I've transmitted the three-pronged breakthrough orders. The eastern route falls to Ye Qing's demonic faction for diversion, the western approach will see Han Lie commanding Xuanwu Sect disciples in a direct assault, and the central strike team will be led by myself and you, pushing straight for the core.' She turned to Chen Ji, a trace of worry flickering in her eyes. 'You're certain about leading the frontal assault personally? The formations within are no trivial matter.'

choice.prompt: The Holy Sect's defensive line loomed before Chen Ji, forcing a critical decision on breakthrough strategy.

choices.description: Charge straight through, crushing the defensive weak points with absolute strength. Swift victory but devastating resource expenditure.
choices.visible_cost: Allied elite casualties may exceed thirty percent.
choices.visible_reward: Can at most争取半个时辰的时间优势.
choices.risk_hint: An overwhelming assault may prematurely expose the main attack intentions.

text.content: Chen Ji drew his sword, its blade gleaming with ethereal azure light. 'Senior Sister Su, lead your team through the left flank—I'll carve the path forward myself. When we encounter formations, don't attempt to break them directly. Follow my movements precisely.' With a single motion, he vanished into the darkness, transforming into a streak of radiance as he lunged toward the vulnerable seam in the seventh formation. His blade carved through the night sky, a brilliant sword light slicing the air and striking the weakened junction of the formation. An enormous breach exploded open, several zhang wide!

Su Qingyao followed in his wake, awe flickering across her features. She'd never witnessed Chen Ji's true capabilities—the disciple dismissed as worthless now displayed sword techniques of terrifying precision, each strike landing exactly on formation nodes. In her understanding, even an Inner Disciple Senior Fellow couldn't match such clean, efficient strikes. 'This person... indeed has been concealing their true strength.' She silently acknowledged, drawing her own blade to clear the path for the elite forces following behind. At the breach, blood mingled with spiritual radiance as the Holy Sect's patrol disciples were shredded before they could react. The alliance's elite forces surged through the opening like a relentless tide, their killing intent soaring skyward.

choices.description: feigned attack draws the main force while an elite squad infiltrates from behind. Unexpected but demands flawless coordination.
choices.visible_cost: Requires precise coordination—any single mistake dooms the entire operation.
choices.visible_reward: Casualties can be minimized to the smallest possible extent.
choices.risk_hint: A single coordination failure could lead to the squad being surrounded.

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head subtly: 'The casualties from an all-out assault are too high—not worth it.' He turned and transmitted a few words to Ye Qing via voice. The demonic path saintess's eyes flickered with understanding, then her lips curved into an enchanting smile. 'Interesting—thistrash... no, this partner suits my taste.' Ye Qing murmured lightly, her slender hand waving. Instantly, demonic fog engulfed a vast area, countless ghost-like demonic shadows beginning to patrol the periphery, creating the illusion of a massive army bearing down. Alarms rang out across the Holy Sect's defensive line as numerous garrison troops were diverted eastward to face the 'main assault.'

In the instant the Holy Sect's garrison's attention was seized, Chen Ji led Su Qingyao and five elites, quietly infiltrating through a concealed valley on the western side. Su Qingyao stayed close to Chen Ji's side, watching him precisely evade one patrol spiritual barrier after another, her heart growing increasingly shaken. 'How do you know these patrol routes?' she couldn't help but ask. Chen Ji offered a light smile, giving no answer. The truth was simple—he had rehearsed this exact scenario countless times within the Tianji Record, every possible variable accounted for in his calculations. After bypassing three defensive lines, a dark dungeon emerged before them, guarded by merely two sentinels at its entrance. Chen Ji's eyes flashed with excitement. 'This is the place.'

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's causal law ability to forcibly rewrite the formation's operation, tearing the defensive line at the cost of one's life.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes 15 Heavenly Fate Value points—Chen Ji will fall into a weakened state.
choices.visible_reward: Can dismantle three defensive formations at once, creating a near-perfect breakthrough window.
choices.risk_hint: A Heavenly Fate that is too low may trigger Heavenly Dao retribution

text.content: "Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, forming a strange mudra with both hands. The Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace violently trembled, and countless threads of causality spread from his Brow Center, creating a bizarre resonance with the entire Holy Sect's formation. Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a hint of terror: 'You madman?! This law of causality is no trifling matter—each thread connects to your Heavenly Fate Foundation. Once you fail...' Chen Ji offered no reply, merely a cold smirk curling at his lips: 'Fail? When have I, Chen Ji, ever failed in my schemes across the world?' The words fell, and he abruptly opened his eyes. Three hundred and sixty threads of causality shattered simultaneously!"

"BOOM—! The three top-grade protective formations the Holy Sect prided itself on collapsed in the same instant, dissolving into countless Spiritual Light fragments scattered across the night sky. Countless guards stood frozen, scarcely believing what unfolded before them. In the distance, Ye Qing witnessed this scene, his pupils constricting: 'This is... the Law of Causality?! He actually dared to use it!' Su Qingyao was also forced back several steps by this overwhelming force, her gaze toward Chen Ji now carrying an inexplicable complexity. Yet at this moment, Chen Ji's face was pallid as paper, beads of sweat rolling down his forehead, his steps so feeble he could barely stand. Mo Xiansheng urgently said: 'Quick! The window is only a quarter-hour—you've overdrawn far too severely!'"

"No matter which route was chosen, the plot would advance to the critical moment of breaking through the defensive line. Chen Ji charged ahead at the very front, his sword dancing like wind, cutting down every enemy who dared obstruct. Su Qingyao followed closely behind, her strength fully displayed tonight—what she demonstrated was by no means a level any Inner Disciple Senior Fellow could reach. Every sword strike carried a devastating might, forming perfect coordination with Chen Ji. 'Three on the left!' Chen Ji called out in a low voice. Su Qingyao didn't even turn back; her sword had already precisely swept through three sword lights, sending three ambushing Holy Sect disciples flying. 'Two behind are yours!' The two moved in flawless tandem, cutting a bloody path through the dense enemy formation. Watching from afar, Han Lie's eyes twitched uncontrollably: 'These two... when did they become so powerful?' The humiliation of being suppressed by this 'trash' grew even stronger in his heart."

"The restrictions in the core area were more terrifying than imagined. Eighteen golden-yellow seals shrouded the entire prison so tightly that not even air could pass through. Each seal was covered in dense, intricate runes, emanating a chilling might. Su Qingyao frowned: 'This is the Holy Sect's sect-protecting great formation, the 'Eighteen Layers of Hell.' At least three Golden Core Stage experts must join forces to break it. We...' Chen Ji cut her off: 'No need to be that troublesome.' He flipped open the Tianji Record Fragment once more, his fingertip resting on those blurred foresight images—while Chen Nian's presence would interfere with the foresight, as long as he wasn't directly observing her, he could still obtain partial information. 'Mo Xiansheng, help me calculate the operational patterns of these eighteen seals.' The remnant soul elder fell silent for a moment, then began explaining each seal's weakness and the sequence to break them. Chen Ji listened while simultaneously conducting mental simulations. In mere dozens of breaths, a complete breaking solution had already taken shape."

"After the breaking began, Su Qingyao finally witnessed the true terror of Chen Ji. This disciple she had always thought was merely lucky now displayedformation造诣—formation knowledge—so shocking it defied belief. He needed no experimentation, no deduction; every gesture, every strand of Spiritual Energy was precise as if rehearsed countless times beforehand. When the ninth seal was broken, a desolate howl echoed from the depths of the prison. That was the reaction of someone imprisoned feeling the seals loosening. Su Qingyao's body shuddered: 'That's...' 'Xiao Nian...' Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly. His fingers gripping the Tianji Record had turned white from force. Twelve years! A full twelve years, and he was finally about to see his sister again. However, just at this moment, an icy laugh drifted from the prison's depths: 'Want to save her? Ask if this one permits it first.' A black shadow slowly emerged from the darkness, releasing an aura of terror that far exceeded the Golden Core Stage—it was Nascent Soul Stage cultivation!"

choice.prompt: The Nascent Soul Stage expert appeared to intercept, forcing Chen Ji to make a choice

choices.description: Even if the opponent is a Nascent Soul expert, carve out a blood path for his sister
choices.visible_cost: Su Qingyao may be severely wounded, the protagonist may also be injured
choices.visible_reward: Can break through the interception in the shortest possible time
choices.risk_hint: The gap between Nascent Soul and Golden Core is like a chasm

text.content: "A trace of resolve flickered through Chen Ji's eyes. The sword in his hand abruptly burst forth with unprecedented radiance: 'Senior Sister Su, please stall him for three breaths of time—I'm going to rescue Xiao Nian first!' Before the words even finished, he had transformed into a streak of light, rushing toward the prison's depths. That Nascent Soul expert coldly snorted: 'A tiny pearl dares to compete for brilliance?' He slapped outward, terrifying Spiritual Energy forming a sky-shrouding giant palm, pressing toward Chen Ji. Yet at this moment, Su Qingyao's figure appeared in front of Chen Ji. A single sword strike emerged, desperately blocking this palm!"

"BOOM—! The aftershock of the collision between the two forces destroyed everything around them. Su Qingyao was sent staggering back several steps, a trace of blood seeping from the corner of her mouth, yet she remained steadfastly before Chen Ji. 'Three breaths of time—I've bought it for you.' She turned to look at Chen Ji, her eyes carrying a complex expression: 'Go quickly. Don't let me down.' Chen Ji gazed deeply at her for a moment. In that instant, he saw the resolve and trust in Su Qingyao's eyes. Without a word, he simply nodded heavily, then rushed toward the prison's depths without hesitation. Three breaths later, Su Qingyao was sent flying by the Nascent Soul expert's palm, blood staining half her garments, yet a smile curved her lips: 'trash... you truly are someone impossible to see through...'"

result_nodes.description: Use the fate chess pieces from the Tianji Record to interfere with the opponent's perception of Chen Nian, buying time for the rescue
result_nodes.visible_cost: Consume three fate chess pieces (equivalent to consuming 9 Heavenly Fate points)
result_nodes.visible_reward: Can take Chen Nian away without being detected
result_nodes.risk_hint: The consumption of fate chess pieces is irreversible

text.content: "Chen Ji did not act rashly. He retrieved three pitch-black chess pieces from the Tianji Record Fragment—these were one of the trump cards he had accumulated over years of scheming across the world. Each chess piece represented a rewritten causality. Once activated, it could briefly blur the target's perception of specific things. 'Go.' The three chess pieces transformed into three streaks of black light, sinking into that Nascent Soul expert's Brow Center. That expert's body swayed, his pupils suddenly dilating: 'What thing... my perception...' 'Now!' Chen Ji seized this fleeting opportunity, his form like a specter sweeping past Su Qingyao and that expert, rushing straight toward the deepest part of the prison."

"In the deepest part of the prison, in a dim cell, Chen Nian was bound by dozens of chains suspended in mid-air. Her face was pale as paper, eyes tightly closed, bizarre light continuously flowing across her body—that was the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' automatically operating. The moment Chen Ji rushed in, she abruptly opened her eyes, a trace of confusion flickering in her gaze, followed by disbelief and wild joy: 'Brother... big brother? Is that you?' Chen Ji gazed at her gaunt face; that string in his heart, taut for twelve years, finally snapped. His trembling hand touched those chains: 'Xiao Nian, big brother came late...' 'Not late...' Chen Nian's tears flowed freely, 'I knew... you would definitely come to rescue me...'"

result_nodes.description: Threaten the opponent by leveraging the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' property on Chen Nian, forcing concessions
result_nodes.visible_cost: May expose the existence of the Tianji Record
result_nodes.visible_reward: May achieve victory without fighting by subjugating the enemy
result_nodes.risk_hint: Exposing the Tianji Record will bring even greater trouble.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped, turned to face the Nascent Soul stage expert, a strange smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Senior, do you know what power she carries?" He pointed at Chen Nian. The expert frowned: "Heavenly Fate Lock Key, our Holy Sect's supreme treasure, what concern is it of yours?" "If I told you that once this Lock Key is forcibly extracted, the entire Holy Sect within a hundred miles will become a sacrificial altar for Heavenly Dao backlash?" Chen Ji's voice was unhurried, yet it made the expert's face change drastically. "You... how do you know this secret?!" Chen Ji coldly laughed: "I know far more than you can imagine. Choose for yourself—mutual destruction, or let us leave."

The Nascent Soul stage expert's expression flickered between阴晴不定. He stared intently at Chen Ji, trying to find any flaw in this seemingly worthless young man. Yet Chen Ji's gaze was terrifyingly calm, as if everything was under his control. After a long moment, the expert finally gritted his teeth and stepped aside: "You'd better keep your word, otherwise..." Chen Ji ignored his threat and walked straight to Chen Nian, beginning to unlock the chains. The moment the last chain fell away, Chen Nian collapsed weakly into his arms—twelve years of imprisonment had reduced her body to an extreme state of weakness. "Go!" Chen Ji picked up Chen Nian, reunited with Su Qingyao, and swiftly retreated. Behind them, the Nascent Soul expert's eyes gleamed with malicious intent, but he didn't give chase. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's ear: "Kid, you won the gamble. Even within the Holy Sect, barely a few people know that secret. Your skill at playing dumb while being a tiger is becoming more refined."

No matter what choices were made before, the moment Chen Ji burst out of the dungeon carrying Chen Nian, the entire battlefield fell into a brief silence. The alliance elite saw their leader had truly rescued the woman imprisoned for twelve years, and immediately erupted into earth-shaking cheers. However, before the cheers faded, an ancient yet authoritative voice descended from the depths of the Holy Sect, like a bucket of cold water poured over everyone's heads—"Brat, put her down, and this one will leave your corpse intact." That was the aura of the Holy Sect's Grand Elder, as deep as an abyss, as oppressive as a prison, making the entire battlefield tremble. Ye Qing's face changed dramatically: "No good! The Grand Elder personally made a move! This old monster was supposedly in seclusion for life and death—how could he..." Chen Ji looked up at the black shadow slowly rising from the Holy Sect's depths, his eyes flashing with cold light. He knew—the most dangerous situation of his entire career had truly arrived.

Chen Nian felt that terrifying pressure and instinctively gripped Chen Ji's sleeve: "Brother... I'm sorry... I'm holding you back again..." Chen Ji lowered his head to look at his weak yet self-blaming sister, a trace of tenderness flickering in his eyes: "Don't talk nonsense. You're the most important person in my life, and no one can take you away from me." He raised his head, staring directly at the black shadow, his voice terrifyingly calm: "Grand Elder, is it? Let me make something clear today—this sister of mine, I'm taking her with me. If your Holy Sect wants to pursue and kill, go ahead. But I'm warning you—if anyone so much as touches a single hair on her head, I'll make the entire Holy Sect bury her!" At these words, the entire battlefield erupted in an uproar. Ye Qing murmured: "This guy... is he truly insane or does he have absolute confidence?" Yet Su Qingyao saw something in Chen Ji's eyes she had never witnessed before—a fanatical, almost obsessive desire to protect, transforming this man who had always presented himself as atrash into someone radiating supreme, world-conquering might.

The Holy Sect's Grand Elder was clearly enraged by these words, and terrifying energy crashed toward Chen Ji like a tidal wave. Yet just at this moment, an unexpected figure stepped forward to shield Chen Ji—it was actually Ling Yuan! That Tianqing Sect Elder who had always shown Chen Ji superficial protection while harboring malicious intentions beneath. "Ling Yuan! What do you think you're doing?!" The Grand Elder's voice carried a hint of fury. Ling Yuan stroked his beard, his smile gentle: "Old friend, long time no see, your temper is still this fierce. My Tianqing Sect's disciples don't need the Holy Sect to discipline." Chen Ji looked at Ling Yuan's back, yet felt no gratitude in his heart. He knew this old fox too well—Ling Yuan's intervention now was definitely not about fraternity; most likely, he had set his sights on the value of Chen Nian's "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" and wanted to use it to coerce Chen Ji. But at this moment, he had no time to dwell on this—the most important thing was to escape alive. Mo Xiansheng's voice urgently rang out: "Kid, stop daydreaming! Take advantage of them bickering and run! I'll guide you on a path—quick!"

choice.prompt: With Ling Yuan's unexpected intervention, Chen Ji must seize this opportunity to retreat.

choices.description: Utilize the opening created by Ling Yuan, immediately retreat following Mo Xiansheng's guidance.
choices.visible_cost: Owe Ling Yuan a massive favor.
choices.visible_reward: Can safely retreat while protecting Chen Nian.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's true intentions are unclear.

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate—he picked up Chen Nian and raced in the direction Mo Xiansheng indicated. Su Qingyao followed closely behind, looking back to maintain vigilance while running. Behind them came the booming sounds of Ling Yuan and the Grand Elder clashing; the residual waves from these two supreme experts' battle made the entire night sky tremble. Ye Qing led the Demonic Path forces in outer perimeter support, and when she saw Chen Ji burst out, the worry in her heart finally settled: "Success! Run!" The alliance elite fought while retreating, and after suffering over a dozen casualties, finally escaped the Holy Sect's sphere of influence. When the first light of dawn scattered across the earth, Chen Ji turned to glance at the distant Holy Sect Mountain Gate, a cold smile forming at the corner of his lips: "Today's grudge, I Chen Ji have recorded it. It won't be long before I'll make you repay it with interest."

result_nodes.description: During the retreat, stay alert to Ling Yuan, preventing being schemed against in secret.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Retreat speed slightly slower, possibly caught by pursuing enemies.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Can defend against Ling Yuan's underhanded moves.
result_nodes.risk_hint: Being distracted may result in being caught by the Grand Elder.

text.content: While retreating, Chen Ji secretly left a hidden Spiritual Consciousness mark in his embrace. This was a technique he had learned from the Tianji Record, which could locate Ling Yuan's movements at critical moments. He didn't believe Ling Yuan would help him without reason—that old fox had a purpose for every action. As expected, after they had retreated to a safe area, Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out: "Kid, you were right. When that old fox Ling Yuan made his move earlier, he secretly left a tracking mark on your sister." A cold light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: "I knew it. He wants to monitor my movements through Little Nian... however, this was also within my expectations." He turned to look at Chen Nian, who had fallen asleep in his arms, and softly said: "Little Nian, Big Brother will protect you. No one will be able to use you again, including that old fox."

Su Qingyao walked to Chen Ji's side, gazing at the sleeping Chen Nian in his arms, and softly asked: "How do you plan to handle the mark Ling Yuan left?" Chen Ji smiled faintly: "Keep it for now. Sometimes, letting an enemy think they've succeeded is more useful than exposing them directly." He lowered his head to look at Chen Nian's sleeping face, a tender light flickering in his eyes. "Once Little Nian's body has recovered somewhat, I'll slowly set up a plan to deal with that old fox. For now, the most important thing is to let her rest well." Ye Qing came over, and seeing Chen Nian's condition, couldn't help but sigh: "The power of the Heavenly Fate Lock Key has been dwelling within her for twelve years—completely purging it won't happen overnight. What are your next plans?" Chen Ji was silent for a moment: "First, send Little Nian somewhere safe to heal from her injuries, then... I have many scores to settle." His voice was calm, yet his eyes were deep as an abyss, as if contemplating some world-shaking scheme. Mo Xiansheng smiled approvingly: "Good, not arrogant nor impatient,懂得endured. You're becoming more and more like Chen Xuan in his prime."

result_nodes.description: Turn back regardless to fight the Grand Elder, vowing to never retreat.
result_nodes.visible_cost: Chen Nian may be injured, oneself may fall on the spot.
result_nodes.visible_reward: Can intimidate all enemies for a period of time.
result_nodes.risk_hint: Extremely dangerous, may result in total annihilation.

text.content: "Just as everyone was preparing to retreat, Chen Ji suddenly stopped. He handed Chen Nian to Su Qingyao and turned to face the approaching shadow. 'You go first.' Su Qingyao was greatly alarmed: 'Chen Ji, you're mad! That's the Grand Elder, a supreme powerhouse at the late Nascent Soul stage!' Chen Ji didn't answer, only slowly drawing his long sword, its blade flowing with the power of the Tianji Record Fragment. When the Grand Elder saw this, he coldly smiled: 'An ant dares to resist?' Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes erupting with a shocking battle intent: 'Chen Ji has never retreated in his life. If you want to take my sister today, you'll have to step over my corpse!' With that, he actually charged toward the Grand Elder, his long sword transforming into a brilliant river of stars!"

"BOOM—! At the moment the two forces collided, the entire heavens and earth lost their color. Chen Ji was blasted flying, blood spewing from his mouth, but he still死死地 blocked in front of Chen Nian. A flash of astonishment crossed the Grand Elder's eyes: 'Interesting, actually able to block one move from this Seat. But that's all.' Just as he prepared to strike again, a golden light shot out from Chen Ji's chest, directly piercing into the Grand Elder's brow center. That was—the power of the Tianji Record! The Grand Elder's body wavered, his pupils suddenly dilating, as if he had seen something terrifying. 'This is... impossible! This aura... Heaven's Eye?!' His voice actually carried a hint of fear, and the next moment he vanished in a flash of light. Everyone stood frozen, not understanding what had happened. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying exhaustion: 'That was close... This old man used the primordial power of the Tianji Record to disrupt his perception, making him see something he shouldn't have. This move can only be used once, and this old man will need to sleep for some time again. Lad, the remaining path... you'll have to walk it yourself...'"

"Just as Chen Ji thought everything was settled, the night sky beyond the Forbidden Grounds suddenly lit up with three dark cyan signal flames—the highest-level alarm of the Tianqing Sect! Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul abruptly emerged from the first page, his voice unusually urgent: 'Bad! The Holy Sect detected the movement ahead of schedule, the defense line adjustment is two hours earlier than expected!' Chen Ji took a deep breath, his fingertips gently stroking the Tianji Record Fragment, those densely packed lines of destiny trembling violently. He raised his head to gaze at the faintly reddening night sky in the distance, his eyes flashing with cold light: 'Since we've been exposed, we attack by force. Pass the order—the third contingency plan, everyone in position within a quarter hour!'"

"After successfully bringing Chen Nian out of the imprisonment location, the entire alliance was immersed in the joy of surviving the catastrophe. However, just then, a blinding golden pillar of light suddenly erupted across the sky—that was the Holy Sect's highest-level alarm! Chen Ji's expression slightly changed: 'Bad, the Holy Sect's net has been activated!' Ye Qing frowned: 'The net? Isn't that only activated when the Holy Sect faces an extinction-level crisis?' Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded, carrying a solemn weight: 'That's because of your sister. Once the Destiny Lock Key is taken beyond the Holy Sect's boundaries, it triggers the entire sect's protective formation. Now the entire Holy Sect will know your location, and they'll mobilize all forces to encircle and annihilate you in the shortest time.' Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the sleeping Chen Nian in his arms, a flash of determination crossing his eyes: 'Since it's come to this, let them come and chase. I'd like to see how many people the Holy Sect can send to die.' He raised his head to gaze into the distance, his eyes cold as blades, 'This time, I, Chen Ji, will let them know—anyone who dares to touch my sister, even to the ends of the earth, I will make them pay in blood!' Morning light fell upon Chen Ji,镀上一层金色的光芒. At this moment, the youth who had always pretended to be atrash finally revealed his true fangs. The Holy Sect's pursuit is about to arrive, and Chen Ji's legend has just begun."
